ownerUpdate: Oct 25: the Ahrefs pull planned for Oct 26-27 is cancelled. The repo data is all there is. Pages with no recorded volume carry an estimate from Search Console, related searches, competitor pages or Google Trends, with a confidence field.

sources: Planned, not yet written: data/god-build/plan.src.json and data/god-build/taxonomy.src.json, minus pages with content/guides/<slug>.json or content/guides-scheduled/<slug>.json, minus the tick and mosquito state series (ticks-in-*, mosquitoes-in-*, *-by-state, *-by-province).

Research files: research/volume-20-2026-10-23.md, next-wave-research.md/.json, next-50.json, comparables-research.md, 200k-comparables.md, path-to-50k.md/.json, research/winners-gap.md, bettertermite-teardown.md, data/us-pages/keywords.json (Oct 7 Ahrefs), data/us-targets.json. Every recorded volume was parsed into one keyword table (737 keywords); the newest file wins when two disagree.

Search Console (sc-domain:buzzskito.ca), read-only API, single "query" dimension, dataState "all", 2026-07-27 to 2026-10-24 (90 days): 97860 query rows (all countries) and 37851 rows filtered to the US. Totals for the window: 3,010,534 impressions, 27,379 clicks (US 862,000 impressions). Query rows exclude anonymised queries.
method.coverageCheck: A topic was dropped when a live page (app/blog, app/learn, app/tools, root routes, content/guides) already targets its head keyword (guide keyword or alsoTargets, page slug or title). Canadian pages do not block a planned or research-recommended US edition (marked usEdition, with the Canadian page under overlapsWith).
method.searchConsoleAttribution: Each query is given to at most one owner: the candidate or live page whose target words it contains most specifically (up to 2 extra words). If a live page owns it at least as specifically, it is not counted. Local-service searches (GTA city names, "near me", exterminator, services) and retailer names (Canadian Tire, Home Depot, Amazon...) are never counted (3077 queries skipped), and product or brand searches (trap, spray, bait, fogger, brand names) are not counted for identification or how-to pages. gscQueriesOver200 lists the topic's queries with 200+ impressions (the brief's proof-of-demand test; every candidate lacks a dedicated page by construction).

confidence.high: a recorded Ahrefs US volume for the head keyword (keyword-level figure in a research file).
confidence.medium: no head volume, but at least one of: recorded Ahrefs volumes for the page's own variant searches; 50+ Search Console impressions in 90 days on the topic's queries; a competitor page's Ahrefs traffic estimate; a Google Trends ratio in next-50.json or next-wave-research.json; or (last resort, not for hubs or location pages) a same-words related search.
confidence.low: no sizing evidence in the repo (sometimes Google autocomplete suggestions, which prove demand exists but not its size). These sit at the bottom.

method.demandEstimate: usMonthlySearches in Ahrefs-US units. High: head volume plus the recorded volumes of the page's own variants (clusterVolume). Medium: the largest floor among variant volumes, Search Console impressions per month / 0.26 (path-to-50k.md section 2: Search Console records about 0.26 impressions per Ahrefs search for page-one queries) and a competitor page's visits; if none exists, the Trends ratio x 175,000 (next-50 calibration, spread 52,000-310,000, given as range). basis says which term and file. Low: null.
method.rankKey: Sort key within a confidence tier: the larger of 0.26 x usMonthlySearches (expected monthly impressions on page one) and the topic's measured Search Console impressions per month. It ranks; it does not forecast. Ahrefs overstates what this site sees (next-50: 20-40x for whole topics) and our US positions run 2-10 places worse than the all-country ones (volume-20).
method.season: Google Trends Nov-Mar factor for the head keyword where the repo has one (0.85+ winter, 0.60-0.85 year-round, under 0.60 summer; terms the research flags as polluted are skipped); otherwise judged from the pest's biology. seasonBasis says which.
